Hello, and my name is Ally Thomas! I am from Greenwood, Arkansas, and my major is Industrial Engineering. I also have a minor in Engineering Management. I am an Honors College Fellow graduating in 2028. I completed my first year as an engineering student. I chose Industrial Engineering because it fuses my two passions: math and efficiency. I eventually added an Engineering Management minor, as my goal is to achieve a leadership position in my career and oversee a team.
